nova.title: THE RISING HERO
nova.description: The first spark of ascension. Every ascendant begins as NOVA — raw potential awaiting calibration by the network.
nova.power: Kinetic ignition — accelerating momentum with every keystroke.

vanguard.title: THE DEFENDER
vanguard.description: A steadfast frontline classification. VANGUARD holds the line with disciplined, dependable input.
vanguard.power: Bulwark protocol — absorbing pressure without breaking rhythm.

phantom.title: THE SHADOW
phantom.description: Silent and precise. PHANTOM strikes between the intervals, unseen until the analysis is complete.
phantom.power: Cloak vector — moving faster than the system can trace.

titan.title: THE POWERHOUSE
titan.description: Overwhelming force. TITAN converts raw throughput into unstoppable pressure across the matrix.
titan.power: Siege engine — sustained output that never yields.

aegis.title: THE PRECISION GUARDIAN
aegis.description: Flawless discipline. AEGIS is unlocked only through near-perfect accuracy — every character verified.
aegis.power: Perfect ward — a shield forged from zero errors.

pulse.title: THE REACTIVE
pulse.description: Pure reaction speed. PULSE thrives on rhythm, converting reflex into a continuous wave of output.
pulse.power: Reflex surge — instant response to every signal.

nexus.title: THE STRATEGIST
nexus.description: The convergence point. NEXUS balances speed, accuracy and consistency into a single optimized flow.
nexus.power: Network sync — orchestrating every metric in harmony.

ascendant.title: THE ELITE
ascendant.description: Beyond the threshold. ASCENDANT marks the point where performance becomes mastery.
ascendant.power: Transcend protocol — operating above standard limits.

velocity.title: THE SPEED SPECIALIST
velocity.description: Terminal velocity. VELOCITY pushes throughput to the edge of what the network can register.

sovereign.title: THE ULTIMATE
sovereign.description: The apex of the original ten. SOVEREIGN is the complete convergence of speed, precision and control — the line every ascendant used to call the finish, before the Transcendent tier proved there was more system left to measure.
sovereign.power: Total ascension — command over every metric the original ten could measure.

apex.title: THE TRANSCENDENT
apex.description: Beyond the elite tier's ceiling. APEX marks the point where conventional performance stops being the limit — the first classification the network measures beyond expectation.
apex.power: Transcendent surge — output the standard scale was never built to hold.

overdrive.title: THE LIMIT BREAKER
overdrive.description: Past the operating range. OVERDRIVE runs the system beyond its expected maximum — every prior boundary treated as a starting line.
overdrive.power: Overdrive protocol — sustained output past the system's own limiters.

paragon.title: THE PERFECTED
paragon.description: Speed and precision in near-perfect sync. PARAGON is what happens when extreme output stops costing accuracy at all.
paragon.power: Perfected sequence — maximum velocity without a single wasted motion.

eclipse.title: THE UNSEEN
eclipse.description: Fast enough to disappear. At ECLIPSE's execution speed, individual actions blur past what the network can distinguish in real time.
eclipse.power: Eclipse vector — motion too fast for the trace to resolve.

dominion.title: THE COMMANDER
dominion.description: Total command. DOMINION holds complete authority over speed, precision and execution — nothing left to chance, nothing left uncontrolled.
dominion.power: Dominion field — command extended over every metric at once.

inferno.title: THE OVERCHARGED
inferno.description: The performance core running past conventional maximum output. INFERNO is what the network looks like when the ceiling itself starts to give.
inferno.power: Overcharge cascade — energy output beyond rated capacity.

zenith.title: THE ABSOLUTE
zenith.description: The upper extreme of measurable elite performance. ZENITH sits at the edge of what the classification system was designed to register.
zenith.power: Zenith state — peak output at the very edge of the measurable range.

paradox.title: THE IMPOSSIBLE
paradox.description: A combination the system flags as anomalous: extreme speed with exceptional accuracy that shouldn't coexist at this range — and does anyway.
paradox.power: Paradox state — two metrics the network assumed were mutually exclusive, both maxed at once.

eternal.title: THE UNENDING
eternal.description: Extreme velocity sustained, not just reached. ETERNAL proves the pace holds over a full 120-second simulation, not one lucky burst. Recommended validation: 120-second simulation.
eternal.power: Eternal cadence — extreme pace that never breaks stride.

infinite.title: THE UNBOUNDED
infinite.description: The final classification. Past 300 WPM with exceptional accuracy and consistency sustained across a full run — the absolute measurable limit of the Ascendancy system. Limit not found. Required validation: 120-second simulation.
infinite.personality: Boundless, absolute, the end of the scale.
infinite.power: Infinite ascension — the system stops measuring, because there's nothing left above it.
